spriteSet.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent cinematic website lightning VFX overlay, first charge frame. Input image 1 is the approved centered impact sprite; use only its lightning style, color, and scale. Create a faint, very thin branching filament at the upper end of the same strike path, around x=58% of a wide 2:1 canvas, extending only from y=7% to y=28%. Add a tiny white-green source glint at the top. Leave the rest fully transparent. Preserve true alpha. No clouds, no broad glow, no ground, no landscape, no coin, no other bolt, no detached marks, no text, no watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: full-canvas transparent VFX overlay for a cinematic website hero. Input image 1 is an existing lightning overlay; use it only as a color and energy-style reference. Create one single, narrow jagged yellow-green lightning bolt striking the ground. Compose on a wide 2:1 transparent canvas; the bolt descends from x=58% near the top edge to a compact white-hot impact at x=58%, y=84%. Give the bolt a crisp white core, a restrained lime-green edge glow, a few fine branches, and only a small localized burst of sparks at the impact. Keep the bolt as the only visible subject. Preserve true transparency everywhere else. Change only the lightning artwork. Avoid all cloud forms, green fog, soft glowing blobs, detached marks, a second bolt, mountains, coin, landscape, shadows, text, or watermark.
